entities.name: Jean-Marie Valhubert

entities.summary: Jean-Marie Mellon Roger, better known as le général Valhubert, was born on 22 October 1764 in Avranches, Normandy, and died on 3 December 1805 in Brünn. He was a French General during the French Revolution.
